title: hyperlite: modernized SuperLite IMC-DDMC radiation transport for interacting supernovae
description: Modernized fork of SuperLite (Wagle et al. 2023, ApJ 953 132): a 1-D spherical multi-group Implicit Monte Carlo / Discrete Diffusion Monte Carlo (IMC-DDMC) radiation-transport code for spectral synthesis of interacting transients, descended from SuperNu. The fork adds a modern CMake/CTest build with CI, a statistical regression suite, HDF5 I/O, a counter-based Philox RNG with thread-count-independent results, SoA+OpenMP performance work (5.4x on the reference case), packaged Python tools, documentation, and physics correctness fixes.
